summary.headline: HumbleStudio now has a working hybrid design viewer plus native and localhost local-first HumbleSudoku loading, review, navigation, and proposal surfaces that make the read-only-to-authoring path visible without claiming source write-back yet.
notes: Percentages are directional maturity estimates, not precise scorecards.
Repo-owned status belongs in this file so shared tooling reads repo truth instead of replacing it.
The new HS ticket store should own future non-trivial HumbleStudio work.
The web and native loaders can now truthfully offer a small supported-app catalog, including direct load and transparent URL-prefill paths.
The native supported-app HumbleSudoku action now resolves the adjacent local HumbleSudoku bundle first and can run the allowlisted HumbleSudoku export command when that bundle is missing.
The localhost web preview now exposes a safe allowlisted HumbleSudoku export endpoint, so clicking HumbleSudoku can load the local bundle before falling back to the remote URL.
Read-only workflow surfaces should stay truthful and avoid mutating repo state implicitly.
Review queue and navigation audit cards now reuse shared proposal scope truth instead of each inferring proposal linkage independently.
Native preview chrome now models selected-device safe-area geometry instead of only displaying raw inset metadata.
Proposal workspace now exposes an authoring-readiness rail for source inspection, proposal capture, validation, and the blocked future edit/apply gate.

refresh_cadence.repo_workflow: Refresh after every non-trivial implementation slice and before promotion to main.
refresh_cadence.proposal_linkage: Refresh after saving or editing repo-backed proposal artifacts in docs/change-proposals/.
refresh_cadence.web_fallback: Refresh after any index.html, studio.css, js/, or localhost helper change by running Scripts/check_web_fallback.py.

evidence_commands.summary: The local repo contract validated successfully against the HumbleControl-owned shared standard.
Validated the repo-native HS ticket surface with 90 tickets after adding HS-0092.
The configured local HumbleSudoku bundle and allowlisted export script both exist for the native local-first supported-app resolver.
The localhost preview helper tests cover existing export reuse, missing export generation, unknown app rejection, missing repository reporting, and API path parsing.
A running localhost helper served the real HumbleSudoku bundle endpoint with `X-HumbleStudio-Local-Export: 1`, `X-HumbleStudio-App-Id: humble-sudoku`, and `X-HumbleStudio-Generated: 0`.
Strict repo doctor reported the expected active topic-branch freshness gate at 97% with 3 issue(s) and 0 dirty path(s).
The repo-native ticket board renders HS tickets together with lane occupancy from local repo truth.
The repo-native status surface renders current git, ticket, worktree, and lane context on top of `.humble/status/current.json`.
The repo-native status summary has a reader-friendly text and Mermaid renderer for review and planning.
The static web fallback and localhost helper contract stayed internally consistent after adding the HumbleSudoku localhost supported-app path.
The web fallback source-context and localhost supported-app loader changes are syntactically valid.
HumbleStudio workflow-only checks passed for tickets, contract, web fallback, script compilation, and diff hygiene after the localhost supported-app helper slice.
The native macOS workspace builds after adding local-first HumbleSudoku supported-app loading.
The repo-documented native CI path completed a build-only macOS sanity pass for HS-0091.

operating_layers.label: Native workspace
operating_layers.signal: The macOS workspace is now the primary truthful surface for local supported-app loading, inspection, proposal artifacts, ticket linkage, source-audit posture, read-only apply guidance, contract-driven preview chrome geometry, and visible authoring readiness.
operating_layers.next_move: Verify the HumbleSudoku local supported-app click path in the running workspace, then extract a shared supported-app source contract before adding more local app resolvers.

operating_layers.label: Web fallback
operating_layers.signal: The static viewer remains available as a fallback, and the localhost preview helper now gives HumbleSudoku a local-first supported-app path that can serve or generate the adjacent bundle before the remote URL fallback is used.
operating_layers.next_move: Extract the supported-app source catalog into one shared contract before adding more local app resolvers.

operating_layers.label: Repo workflow
operating_layers.signal: The repository now has contract, ticket, status, lane, proposal-linkage, local check, and authoring-readiness tracking surfaces.
operating_layers.next_move: Keep each authoring/editor step ticketed and evidence-backed so future write-back remains proposal-first.
